subject.title: Feishu: @mention not recognized in group when multiple bots share the same group (open_id app-scoped mismatch)

question: Which Feishu bot identity strategy should become canonical for multi-bot group @mention admission when Feishu open_id values are app-scoped?
rationale: Current source proves the bug path, but the active union_id PR depends on an identity source the reporter says bot/v3/info does not provide and a wrong fallback can continue suppressing or misrouting Feishu group messages.

options.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
options.body: Rework the open PR or replacement branch only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering text, post, command, mention-forward, and debounce paths.

options.title: Document The Feishu Limitation
options.body: If Feishu does not expose a reliable cross-app bot identity, keep requireMention conservative and document supported multi-bot workarounds instead of merging a partial fallback.

options.title: Fold Into Broader Feishu Multi-Bot Design
options.body: Use this issue as part of a larger Feishu multi-bot routing design only if maintainers want one plan for identity, bot-to-bot visibility, and session scope.

recommendation.title: Rewrite Around Proven Identity
recommendation.body: Rework the open PR or replacement branch only after proving the stable Feishu identity source and covering text, post, command, mention-forward, and debounce paths.

likelyOwner.reason: They are assigned to and have already requested changes on the linked Feishu identity PR, making them the best current owner for the item-specific decision.
